description: Host-mediated, single-use password recovery through verified external notification destinations.
name: Password Reset

permissions.rationale: Enable administrator-configured host-mediated password recovery for local accounts. The host owns tokens, password changes and session revocation; this plugin cannot read credentials or bypass destination trust.
Remember whether this installation enables recovery and its configured token lifetime. No reset credentials are stored by this plugin.
Show the administrator-only password recovery configuration entry.
Render and save the administrator configuration field using existing plugin settings controls.
